title: Starting Gate Stills
eyebrow: BadCode Shorts · The Starting Gate · stills round 1
heading: The Starting Gate: stills
intro: Round 1: two takes per shot from a sealed writer, Unsplash photos as layouts. My pick is marked on every shot; overrule any with Pick, and leave a note for anything to change.

sections.lede: Words on the cloths and the mask are checked by eye; problems are written under each still.
